Metadata.title: Integris LaTeX
Metadata.description: Write, collaborate on and compile your LaTeX documents online: theses, articles, reports, courses, CVs. In French and English, with mobile money payments.

footer.tagline: An Integris Cloud service. Collaborative LaTeX editing, in French and English.

hero.eyebrow: From the first line to the final PDF
hero.title: Your ideas deserve <accent>a flawless document</accent>.
hero.lead: Write, collaborate on and compile your LaTeX documents online — theses, articles, reports, courses, CVs. Only your content should matter.
hero.note: Free to start · a phone number is all you need · in French and English

template.title: Template
template.text: Start from a ready-to-fill template, or import your project as a ZIP

writing.title: Writing
writing.text: Write together, in real time, in the same document

review.title: Review
review.text: Comments in the text and suggested corrections

versions.title: Versions
versions.text: Every version kept, restorable in one click

pdf.title: Final PDF
pdf.text: A clean PDF, ready to share or to have approved

features.title: Everything you need to write in LaTeX, nothing to install
features.intro: Students, researchers, teachers, freelancers or companies: a browser is all you need, on a computer or a phone.

editor.title: A complete LaTeX editor
editor.text: Syntax highlighting, autocompletion of commands, \ref and \cite, document outline, find and replace across the whole project.

compile.title: Compilation on our servers
compile.text: pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX with the full TeX Live. The first errors are translated and link to the right line.

realtime.title: Real-time collaboration
realtime.text: Invite co-authors by phone or email, with a role: editor, reviewer or viewer.

comments.title: Comments and suggestions
comments.text: Comment on a selection, reply, resolve. A suggested replacement is applied in one click.

history.title: Version history
history.text: An automatic version after each work session, named versions, and restore any of them.

mobile.title: On your phone too
mobile.text: Read the PDF, comment, compile and follow submissions from a phone, even on a modest connection.

supervision.title: Get your work reviewed and approved
supervision.intro: A thesis, a dissertation, an article or a report: send a frozen version, get feedback in the text and a clear approval.

share.title: Share with a role
share.text: Invite a supervisor who comments, suggests, sets deadlines and approves, or a reviewer and a viewer.

submit.title: Submit a frozen version
submit.text: Choose the files to review, add a message and a deadline. The version you sent no longer changes.

validate.title: Get approval
validate.text: Feedback, corrections, a new submission: once the supervisor approves, the submitted files are locked.

orgs.title: For teams, institutions and companies
orgs.text: With Team or Business, the owner pays for the seats and manages the members. Everyone keeps their own projects: paying never gives access to their content.
orgs.exams: Business: confidential exam papers sent to the secretariat

pricing.title: Start for free, pay when you need it
pricing.intro: Prices in FCFA, taxes included. Pay by mobile money via LigdiCash, PDF receipt sent by email, no automatic renewal charge. Every plan lets you submit a document to a supervisor.
pricing.unavailable: Pricing is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

latex.question: I don't know LaTeX. Is this for me?
latex.answer: Yes. Start from a ready-to-fill template; the most common compilation errors are explained in French and English, with a link to the line concerned.

payment.question: How can I pay without a bank card?
payment.answer: By mobile money, via LigdiCash, directly on the platform. Your plan is activated as soon as the payment is confirmed and you receive a PDF receipt by email.

privacy.question: Is my work protected?
privacy.answer: Nobody can open a project without an invitation. Every compilation runs in an isolated environment. In a team or an institution, whoever pays sees usage, never the content of your projects.

import.question: Can I bring an existing project?
import.answer: Yes: import it as a ZIP, including an Overleaf export. The main file is main.tex by default and you can choose another one.

cta.title: Your next document can start today.
cta.text: A phone number is all you need to create your account.
